confirm.description: Do you want to start setup?

data_description.pin: Optional. Enter the 4-digit PIN if your device requires one; leave it blank otherwise. If the device later shows as unavailable with no re-authentication prompt, set, verify, or clear the PIN via the integration's Reconfigure option.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter PIN
reauth_confirm.description: The device rejected the saved PIN. Enter the correct 4-digit PIN. To change or remove the PIN instead, use the integration's Reconfigure option.

data_description.pin: The 4-digit PIN required by the device.

reconfigure.title: Change PIN
reconfigure.description: Set, change, or clear the device PIN. Leave it blank to remove the PIN (for a device that does not use PIN login). If a reachable device is stuck unavailable with no re-authentication prompt, the firmware may need a PIN that was not set, the PIN may be wrong, or the device may not use PIN login.
